name: module-ignore-directive-leaves-out-directories
description: A directory a module's ignore directive names, a ./ path from the module root or any other path at any depth, holds none of the module's Go: no package of it is the module's, so nothing in it is reported, and neither a package below an underscore directory in it nor a script of a dropped module in a directory that module ignores counts a reference. A package in such a directory that the module imports is compiled by its build all the same, so its references count.
